decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development by virtue of its size, design, mass, bulk and location would have an unduly adverse effect on the amenity of adjacent residential properties, in terms of overlooking and loss of privacy. The proposal is therefore contrary to POlicies ENV.1.1 and H.2.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policies ENV.B.1.1 and H.4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development by virtue of its size, design, mass, bulk and location would have an adverse effect on the amenities of adjacent residential properties in terms of loss of outlook and overbearing effect. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, H.2.1 and H.3.3 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policies ENV.B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 3 - The mass and bulk of the proposed building together with the lack of architectural features would result in a building which fails to have due regard to its location and fails to relate to the adjacent residential properties. It is therefore contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.3 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policies ENV.B.1.1 and H.6.3 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development does not provide sufficient affordable housing, for which there is an identified need within the Borough. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy H.4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policy H.2.1 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 5 - The size, location, absence of amenity space and impact on adjacent properties means that the proposal constitutes an overdevelopment of the site to the detriment of the character of the area and amenity of adjacent properties. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy H.3.3 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policy H.6.3 of the Unitary Development PLan Revised Deposit 2001.
description: Erection of 36 two bedroomed flats and 7 one bedroomed flats including 3 units of affordable housing together with associated access road and parking.  Duplicate applications received.
